description:
Encode a decimal (0.1, 6.02e23), exact fraction (1/3), hex float (0x1.8p3), inf or nan into IEEE 754-2019 binary16, binary32 or binary64 with round-to-nearest-even, or decode a hex or binary bit pattern. Returns sign, exponent and fraction bits, the class (normal, subnormal, zero, infinity, NaN with payload), the exact decimal value stored, the shortest round-trip decimal, the rounding error, nextUp/nextDown and the bytes in both byte orders.

Returns: JSON { format, bits, hex, bytesBigEndian, bytesLittleEndian, sign, exponentBits, fractionBits, biasedExponent, exponent, class, formula, exactValue, shortest, ulp, nextUp{ hex, value }, nextDown{ hex, value }, nan{ quiet, payload, payloadHex }|null, rounding{ input, exact, error, relativeError, overflow, underflow }|null }.
Example input: {"value":"0.1","format":"binary32"}
On error, includes hint: Encode accepts decimals, p/q fractions, C hex floats, inf and nan. Decode takes up to the format's width in big-endian order: 4, 8 or 16 hex digits, or a 0b-prefixed binary pattern (unprefixed binary must be exactly 16, 32 or 64 digits).

format.description: binary16 (half), binary32 (float, single) or binary64 (double). Default binary32.

mode.description: encode a number (default) or decode a bit pattern.

value.description: A number to encode, or a bit pattern to decode (hex such as 3DCCCCCD or 0x3FB999999999999A, or binary).

name: ieee754_float
title: IEEE 754 float converter
